import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import SpectralClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify highly correlated features (|r| >= 0.6)
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x.T)
    high_corr_mask = np.abs(corr_matrix) >= 0.6
    np.fill_diagonal(high_corr_mask, False)
    
    # Find connected components in correlation graph
    clustering = SpectralClustering(n_clusters=1, affinity='precomputed', 
                                   assign_labels='discretize')
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(high_corr_mask.astype(int))
    
    # Get the largest cluster
    unique_clusters, counts = np.unique(clusters, return_counts=True)
    main_cluster_id = unique_clusters[np.argmax(counts)]
    module_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in range(len(feats.ids)) if clusters[i] == main_cluster_id]
    
    if len(module_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Compute weighted score using first principal component
    module_data = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in module_features]]
    _, _, vh = np.linalg.svd(module_data, full_matrices=False)
    weights = vh[0] / np.linalg.norm(vh[0])
    
    loadings = dict(zip(module_features, weights))
    
    # Select top features based on t-statistics
    t_stats = []
    for fid in module_features:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        y0_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, col_idx])
        y1_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, col_idx])
        t_stat = (y1_mean - y0_mean) / (np.std(feats.x[:, col_idx]) + 1e-8)
        t_stats.append(abs(t_stat))
    
    # Sort by t-statistic and limit to MAX_DRIVERS-1 (leave room for main driver)
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:min(MAX_DRIVERS-1, len(module_features))]
    drivers = tuple([module_features[i] for i in sorted_indices])
    
    # Include all module features in regression
    columns = tuple(module_features)
    
    # No products needed for this approach
    products = ()
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
